fixtures.purpose: Nuts/air versus bluffcatcher, pot-size bet, finite tree
Weighted river range, two opening sizes, raises and unequal stacks

methodology.cost: T=10000 trained sweeps for each case including four observational snapshots; tail uses weights t over3001..10000, not max(t-D,0). Raw single-call/capture, conversion, replay times separate. No speedup, allocation/RSS or general convergence claim.
methodology.diagnostics: Full production diagnostics compared independently. Prefix/tail diagnostics derived by independent numeric-rule replay and complete legal visible-information BR search; not independently compared production values.
methodology.numerics: Exact binary64-to-Fraction row normalization and flow arithmetic; row/negative gate1e-12, complete reconstructed flow gate1e-11. Corrections/fallbacks explicitly recorded; no formal trainer rounding bound.
methodology.preconditions: Same-run post-sweep linear CFR+ averages, independently validated complete legal perfect-recall profiles; own-sequence realization subtraction.
methodology.scope: Research-only two synthetic finite river games; production/shared/earlier-street/Coach source unchanged. All target misses retained.
methodology.selection: Fixed existing two river fixtures x both backends; original-weight tail D3000/T10000, no adaptive selection or omitted cases.

report_amendments.reason: Read-only review found summary metrics are independently replayed, including full profiles; production diagnostics are compared separately.
